title: Personal Greeting Card
description: Create an interactive greeting card that updates in real-time as the user types.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Build a Vue app that acts as a dynamic greeting card. The user should be able to enter:

- Their name
- A message (optional)
- Choose a theme (light/dark)

The card should update **instantly** as the user types or changes the theme. It should display:

```
Hello, [Name]!
[Optional Message]
```

If no name is entered, default to "Friend".

The theme should change the card's background and text color (light theme: white background, black text; dark theme: dark gray background, white text).

Use **v-model** for two-way binding and **:class** or **:style** for dynamic styling.

**Bonus**: Add an emoji selector (😊, 😎, 🚀) that changes an emoji displayed next to the greeting.
hints: Use `v-model` to bind input fields to data properties.
For conditional styling, use `:class` with an object or `:style`.
To display the default name, you can use a computed property or a conditional in the template: `{{ name || 'Friend' }}`.
For the emoji bonus, store the selected emoji in data and update it when the user selects a new one.
expectedOutput: A fully interactive greeting card with live updates and theme switching.
